scripts.build: npm run build -w @call-screener/contracts && npm run build -w @call-screener/api && npm run build -w @call-screener/mobile
scripts.start: npm run db:migrate -w @call-screener/api && if [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "worker" ]; then node apps/api/dist/worker.js; else node apps/api/dist/server.js; fi
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @call-screener/contracts && npm run build -w @call-screener/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @call-screener/api && npm run typecheck -w @call-screener/mobile
